1: Allah sooraj ki qasam khata hai, aur us ke mashriqi ufuq se phoot kar nikalne ki.
2: Aur woh chaand ki bhi qasam khata hai jab woh sooraj ke doobne ke baad us ke peechhe aata hai.
3: Aur Allah din ki bhi qasam khata hai jab woh apni roshni se zahir kar deta hai jo kuch zameen ki satah par hai.
4: Aur woh raat ki bhi qasam khata hai jab woh zameen ki satah ko dhanp leti hai aur usey tareek kar deti hai.
5: Aur woh aasman ki qasam khata hai, us ki kaamil takhleeq ki qasam.
6: Aur woh zameen ki bhi qasam khata hai, is baat ki ke usey kis tarah phailaya gaya taake log us par reh sakein.
7: Aur woh har jaan ki bhi qasam khata hai, jisey us ne barabar paida kiya.
8: Phir us ne, bagair sikhaye, usey samjha diya ke buraai kya hai taake us se bacha jaye, aur bhalai kya hai taake us par amal kiya jaye.
9: Beshak woh shaks kamiyab hua jis ne apne nafs ko achhi khasiyaton se sanwar kar aur buri aadaton se paak kar ke suthra kar liya.
10: Aur beshak woh shaks ghaate mein raha jis ne apne nafs ko chupke se gunahon aur nafarmani mein daal diya.
11: Allah ne us shaks ke ghaate ka zikr kiya jo apne nafs ko chupke se gunahon mein daal deta hai. Phir us ne Samood ko is ki misal ke taur par bayan kiya aur farmaya: Samood ne apne Nabi Saleh ko jhutlaya, kyunke woh gunahon aur nafarmani mein hadd se barh gaye thay.
12: Jab un mein sab se bad-bakht shaks khara hua, us ke baad ke us ki qaum ne usey is kaam ke liye muqarrar kiya.
13: Allah ke Rasool Saleh (alaihis salaam) ne un se kaha: “Allah ki oontni ko chhor do; usey us ke din par paani peene do, aur buri niyat se us ke peechhe na paro.”
14: Magar unhon ne oontni ke maamle mein apne Rasool ko jhutlaya, aur un mein se sab se bad-bakht shaks ne apni qaum ki razamandi se usey qatl kar diya. Is liye woh sab is jurm ke mujrim thehre, aur Allah ne unhein apne azaab mein gher liya aur un ke gunahon ki wajah se ek chikh se unhein halak kar diya. Jis azaab se us ne unhein halak kiya, us mein us ne un sab ko barabar rakha.
15: Allah ne woh azaab un par muqarrar kiya jis ne unhein halak kar diya, aur usey, jo paak hai, apne kaamon par kisi malamat ka koi khauf na tha.
